title: feat(studio): a permission set opens full-screen at its metadata address; the sharing overview gets its own route
body:
Part of #36905

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在 Studio 里点开一个权限集，右侧整块显示权限矩阵，左上角 × 回到权限集列表，页签里能看引用、历史和源码；「谁能看到哪些记录」有了自己的页面，在左侧菜单「访问」里；旧书签自动跳到新地址。
- 为什么做：Studio 重构专题里「权限集矩阵全屏、默认共享总览独立」这一项，让权限集和其他元数据一样从列表点开、全屏编辑。
- 出错会怎样：有未保存修改时离开会先问；AI 留下的草稿有提示并可一键放弃；本改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：卡里第 5 项（删除旧的权限侧栏和它的测试）约 4,500 行，会让这张卡超过 3,000 行，按您的规则先停下：请定放进「删分区路由和残留」那张卡，还是这张卡按人审走。

## What changes

A permission set now opens full-screen at its metadata address, and the organization-wide default sharing overview has a route of its own. The Access pillar draws no page any more: every address it answered redirects.

1. **The set's full-screen page** (`StudioPermissionSetPage`, new). On a package's leg, `/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/permission/NAME` opens the matrix (`PermissionMatrixEditPage`, its Studio presentation) in the area instead of sending the set to the Access pillar (`AREA_DESIGNER_PAGE_TYPES` / `areaItemOpensDesignerPage` in `metadataArea.ts`). The header is the full-screen detail's (`ResourceDetailHeader`, from #36892/#36901): × back to the list with its context, ‹ › through it, label, API name, type and package, ⋯. The tab row is the matrix's five sections, then `ItemToolTabs`' References, History (with the audit log) and Source; a tool tab is addressable (`?tab=`) and keeps the matrix mounted and hidden. The matrix gains one optional seam for this, `studio.frame` (`renderHeader`, `toolOpen`, `toolPanel`, `onDraftChangesRead`); without it the matrix draws its own header exactly as before. The cross-package leg (`/studio/~all/...`) keeps the matrix's environment page.
2. **What the pillar drew around the matrix comes along.** Discard draft, Explain access, the suggested-audience strip, and on a read-only base "New similar": in ⋯ on the page, and as a row action on the base's own rows in the list of sets (`ResourceListPage`). The copy opens at its own metadata address with the strip saying where it landed (`permissionNewSimilar.tsx`, shared with the pillar). Unsaved edits: the matrix registers with the shell's leave guard and the top bar's Save, so ×, ‹ ›, the menu, a reload and a tab close ask first; the browser's Back is not guarded (epic decisions 1 and 12).
3. **Card item 6, decided here.** An AI-written pending draft (copilot or MCP) gets the designers' notice (`StudioAiDraftNotice`) with 「放弃 AI 的改动」, which drops that one set's draft at its package and asks first only when the matrix holds unsaved edits: the rule #37026 applied to the generic item page. A person's own leftover draft keeps Discard draft (decision 14). The matrix reports the draft's `draftChanges` from the read it already makes; no new request.
4. **The sharing overview's own route**, `/studio/PACKAGE/owd` (`StudioOwdOverviewPage`, new; `studioOwdOverviewPath`, `STUDIO_OWD_SECTION`), the Access group's menu entry (`studioMenuModel.ts`: its `to` and the current-entry mapping). A set's per-object visibility badge opens it on that object (`?object=NAME`). Its one read-only mark is the header's (objectui#12453), so the panel's own duplicate is gone.
5. **Address switch.** `permission` leaves `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR`, so `studioItemPath` (the palette, the AI artifact links, every producer) answers the metadata address; the menu's designer types are named explicitly so a permission set keeps its entry. `/studio/PACKAGE/access?surface=permission:NAME` redirects to the set's address, `?surface=owd:overview` to the overview, a bare `/access` to the list of sets, other parameters kept (`accessPillarRedirect.ts`). `.../permission/NAME/history` opens the History tab: `AreaHistoryRedirect`'s own-editor exemption no longer covers a designer page. The address table's rows say where each moved (`redirectsTo`).
6. **The copilot keeps its context.** The pillar put the set in `?surface=`; the page's address carries it in the path, so the copilot's surface context reads a designer page's address too (`areaDesignerItemOf`, pillar `metadata`), and the page reports its label, so the chip still reads 「正在看：权限 · 组织成员」 (objectstack#35018). Only designer-page types are read this way; every other area item is unchanged.

**Not done: card item 5.** `AccessPillar` is no longer mounted anywhere (`StudioDesignSurface` keeps its re-export for the 13 test files that render it directly). Deleting it with those tests is about 4,500 changed lines and would take this card past the maintainer's 3,000-line line; this PR stops there and asks where it goes (the leftovers card, #36909, or this card as Tier H). Hence `Part of`, not `Fixes`.

## Tests

<details><summary>New pins</summary>

- `StudioPermissionSetPage.fullScreen-36905.test.tsx` (12): the detail header and no matrix header; section and tool tabs; a tool tab addressable and the matrix kept mounted; × to the list; Discard draft at the set's package, CONTROL none without a draft; the AI notice for copilot and mcp drafts and its discard without a question on a clean page, CONTROL a person's draft; New similar in ⋯ landing at the copy's address with the strip, the no-package answer, CONTROL none on a writable package.
- `accessPillarRedirect.test.ts` (4): set, overview, bare and unknown surfaces, parameters carried.
- `StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561.test.tsx` (+4): the set opens in place on writable and read-only packages, CONTROL the cross-package leg keeps the generic page, the old history address opens the History tab.
- `metadataArea.test.ts`, `studioAddress.test.ts`, `studioMenuModel.test.ts`: the predicate, the address reader, `studioOwdOverviewPath`, the moved rows agree with the redirect, the menu entry and current key.

</details>

<details><summary>Pins moved to the new addresses</summary>

- `StudioDesignSurface.pillarNavGuard.test.tsx`: decision 12 on the set page and the overview page (menu, Back to app, the shell seam; dirty matrix and dirty overview rows; CONTROL clean).
- `StudioDesignSurface.accessPairCopy-29674.test.tsx`: a pair's copy at the pair's address lists the base's objects, saves at the pair, names the base by its label, reads Custom; CONTROL the base's own set.
- `StudioDesignSurface.aiChipLabel.test.tsx`: the chip and the agent's surface context on the set page.
- `accessSegment-12452`: the old Access address lands on the list of sets with its entry current. `notFound-26708`, `readOnlyPosture-12453`, `pillarsClaimSlot-12725`, `rightSlot-12725`, `backToApp-36501`, `changesCount-11787`, `copilotDraftBadge-12725`, `publishPosture-12517` used the Access pillar as "a package page that claims nothing"; they use the overview page now.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one, reverted)</summary>

`const aiDraft = …` forced to `false` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `3dc44aa6` → `fdd76cfd`; the AI-draft describe went 2 failed, 1 passed (the CONTROL); restored blob == HEAD `3dc44aa6`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `StudioDesignSurface`'s `PILLAR_FOR_SURFACE_TYPE` still routes a `permission` surface request through `/access?surface=`, and its "open Access" toast action through bare `/access`; both now land via the redirect. They go with the pillar routes in #36909.
- On a pair's leg the provenance chip reads Custom for every set (`customizationMark: 'added'`): a permission set takes no override (ADR-0005), so a set the pair holds is one it adds.
- The suggested-audience strip draws on every set page, as it drew above every set in the pillar.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: origin/main merges cleanly; #36784 (paused draft) conflicts on `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, and it conflicts with origin/main on that file already (it predates the file's split).

## Verification

First to read:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioPermissionSetPage.tsx` — the page; the discard paths and the New similar landing.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` — the `frame` branch of `renderStudio`: the sections stay mounted under a tool tab.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioAiCopilot.tsx` — the copilot's context now reads a designer page's path.

Two-minute check: on HotCRM, open `/studio/PACKAGE/access?surface=permission:NAME` from an old bookmark — it lands on `/studio/PACKAGE/metadata/permission/NAME?package=PACKAGE`, the matrix full-screen with × in the header; the menu's Access group opens 「谁能看到哪些记录」 at `/studio/PACKAGE/owd`.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

All on `d1ebd74b8` (the head this PR opens with), `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over 149 files that reference Access, OWD, the menu, permission sets or the list (the narrowed affected set; CI runs the whole UI farm): after the fixes, every file that had failed re-run green — 15 files, 115 tests; the page pin 12/12 after the AI-draft cases.
- `ui/packages/app-shell` `type-check` (both `tsc` programs): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 172 files passed, 2 skipped; 5130 tests passed.
- eslint over the changed UI files: 0 errors (warnings are the files' existing ones, plus `react-refresh/only-export-components` on `permissionNewSimilar.tsx`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` families, 37 commands run one by one, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- Ablation as above; one, reverted, restore proven by blob and `git diff HEAD`.

</details>
